extra_quotes: The physical implementation for the three designs has been conducted in GlobalFoundries GF12 technology.
The synthesis flow has been implemented with Synopsys Design Compiler NXT v2025.06 in topographical mode, using the SSPG 0.72V -40°C as the synthesis corner.
The Place and Route has been performed using Cadence Innovus v23.33, considering all worst-case corners.
The Post Layout simulations have been carried out using QuestaSim v2025.3.
